title: Neural Cellular Automata for CFD in Architectural Design
title_zh: 神經細胞自動機運用於建築設計中 CFD 運算
abstract:
Architectural massing converges through continuous, incremental edits, yet wind simulation restarts from a zero field each time, discarding the previous result. This thesis takes from cellular automata one local rule applied repeatedly, of which the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and Neural Cellular Automata (NCA) are its fluid and learning branches. LBM supervises and NCA implements the advance operator LBM-NCA, which holds the solver’s per-cell mesoscopic moments as its state, so a previous flow field transfers losslessly into the next advance. The bottleneck lies in the data, since prevailing surrogates train on unrelated samples and first meet such a start at inference. Warm start becomes a property of the data, the training set a warm-start data graph whose nodes hold mean flow fields and whose edges hold one edit’s continuation. Data, model and application layers meet at that field, closing the loop.

On a two-dimensional laminar-to-transitional testbed (Re ∈ [50, 350]), measurement follows the flow’s failure modes rather than generic metrics. A controlled ablation places that source on the data side, where the starting field’s authenticity exceeds ten times the resolvable floor while design proximity falls within it. Error growth along an edit chain stays below the identity baseline, and a misalignment boundary independent of edit radius appears after tens of edits. A single step takes 7.70 ms (130 FPS), placing feedback within seconds.

The converged state hides edit order, though individual operations remain rankable by influence in the solver’s order, and process readability reaches partial discrimination at best. Performance evaluation thereby moves from a post-hoc check to an in-process reference.
abstract_zh:
建築量體設計以連續而漸進的修改逐步收斂，風場模擬卻每次自零場重算，前一次的流場於下一次修改時全數捨棄。本研究自細胞自動機取用其局部規則反覆施用的推進形式，格子波茲曼法（LBM）與神經細胞自動機（NCA）分別為該形式在流體力學與深度學習上的分支。

以LBM 監督、NCA 實作推進算子LBM-NCA，求解器與模型的格點狀態同為逐格的介觀矩量，前次流場因而得以無損交接為下次推進的起點。接續的瓶頸落在資料，既有代理以互無關聯的獨立配對樣本訓練，模型於推論階段才首次面對前次流場這種起點。本方法將暖啟動改寫為資料的性質，訓練資料重構為暖啟動資料圖，其節點與有向邊分別記錄單一設計的時均流場與一次設計修改的續算。系統依資料、模型、應用三層搭建，三層以時均流場為共通介面，暖啟動迴圈由此閉合。
於二維、層流至過渡流域（Re ∈ [50, 350]）之測試平台，量測依流場的失效型態設項而不沿用通用指標。受控對照將暖啟動的能力來源指向資料側，訓練起點是否為求解器實際算得之時均流場，其效應達可分辨下限的十倍以上，設計鄰近性則落於下限之內。連續修改鏈上的誤差增長速度低於恆等基準，數十次修改之後出現一道與編輯半徑無關的失準邊界。單步推論7.70 毫秒（130FPS），回饋落在互動所需的數秒量級之內。

終態流場無法回推編輯之先後順序，個別操作的影響量級則可依序排列，其排序與求解器一致。重組過程可讀性三軸最強者止於部分區辨。性能評估由此自設計底定後的檢核前移為設計過程中的參照。

title: Optimization of Open Space Pedestrian Routes and Building Morphology Shading Design Considering Urban Pedestrian Thermal Comfort
title_zh: 考量都市行人熱舒適之開放空間行走路徑與建築型態遮陽設計最佳化
abstract:
Taiwan's urban environments lie in a subtropical hot-humid climate, where high summer humidity suppresses evaporative cooling and drives outdoor pedestrian thermal stress to persistently uncomfortable, and at times hazardous, levels. However, the computational latency of high-fidelity numerical simulation (such as Computational Fluid Dynamics and Ladybug Tools) confines microclimate assessment to post-hoc verification rather than early-stage design iteration; prevailing morphological optimization targets a global spatial average and overlooks pedestrians’ dynamic thermal exposure along their routes; and model training data have largely relied on procedurally generated geometry and typical-year weather, lacking external validity in real environments. To address these gaps, this study develops a generative urban design optimization framework that
integrates a Physics-Informed Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network (PI-ST-GNN), a thermal-comfort walkway evaluation, and the Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II). Buildings and air-evaluation points are encoded as distinct node types in a heterogeneous graph; a Relational Graph Convolutional Network with a Long Short Term Memory encoder captures the geometry–time–heat-stress mapping under physics-informed soft constraints, replacing costly numerical simulation to predict the full-field, hourly Universal Thermal Climate Index (UTCI).
To strengthen the surrogate model's real-world credibility, the training data were constructed entirely from real geographic environments: real OpenStreetMap building footprints and heights, ETH global canopy heights for vegetation shading, and hourly air temperature and relative humidity measured by the MOENV IoT station network. From these, 300 real scenes—each simultaneously satisfying criteria of real buildings, landcover heterogeneity, a real IoT station, and real canopy—were selected across the Hsinchu, Taoyuan, Miaoli, and Taichung region, with microclimate simulation performed by the official Radiance/EnergyPlus engine rather than a custom physics approximation. On held-out, unseen real test scenes, the model attained a coefficient of determination of R2 = 0.9753 and a root-mean-square error of 0.83 ◦C, indicating good generalization to the spatial heat-stress structure imposed by real urban geometry. The predicted field then drives thermal-exposure-weighted walkway evaluation and NSGA-II multi-objective morphological optimization, jointly producing optimized building configurations and thermally comfortable walking paths. The contribution of this study lies in anchoring the surrogate model's training in real geospatial data and measured meteorology, and in integrating full-field prediction, walkway thermal-comfort evaluation, and generative optimization into an interactive, closed-loop design-decision workflow for climate-adaptive urban design.
abstract_zh:
台灣都市環境地處副熱帶高溫夏濕氣候帶，夏季高相對濕度抑制人體蒸散冷卻，使戶外行人熱壓力常態性地達到不舒適乃至危險水準。然而，傳統高擬真度數值模擬（如計算流體力學、Ladybug Tools）之運算延遲，使微氣候評估難以進入方案發展前段而僅能事後驗證；現有都市形態最佳化多以全空間平均為目標，忽略行人沿動線之動態熱暴露歷程；加以模型訓練資料多倚賴程序化生成之幾何與典型氣象，缺乏真實地理環境之外部效度。對此，本研究建構一套整合物理資訊時空圖神經網路（Physics-Informed Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network, PI-ST-GNN）、熱舒適人行動線評估與第二代非支配排序遺傳演算法（Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II, NSGA-II）之生成式都市設計最佳化框架：以異質圖將建物與空氣評估節點編碼為相異節點類型，透過關係圖卷積網路與長短期記憶網路捕捉「幾何—時序—熱壓力」之映射，並以物理資訊軟約束確保熱力學一致性，取代高運算成本之數值模擬，預測通用熱氣候指數（Universal
Thermal Climate Index, UTCI）之全場域逐時分布。
為提升代理模型於真實世界應用之可信度，本研究以真實地理環境建構訓練資料：自 OpenStreetMap 取真實建物足跡與樓高、以 ETH 全球樹冠高度取真實植栽
遮蔽，並以環境部智慧城鄉 IoT 測站之逐時實測氣溫與相對濕度驅動微氣候模擬，於新竹、桃園、苗栗、臺中區域篩選 300 個同時具備真實建物、地表異質性、真實測站與真實樹冠之場景，並以 Radiance ／ EnergyPlus 官方模擬引擎取代自製物理近似式。模型於保留之未見過真實測試場景達決定係數 R2 = 0.9753、均方根誤差 0.83 ◦C，顯示其對真實都市幾何所主導之空間熱壓力結構具良好一般化能力。此一預測場進而驅動考量熱暴露成本之人行路徑評估與 NSGA-II 多目標建築形態最佳化，同步輸出最佳化建築形態配置與涼適人行路徑。本研究之貢獻在於：以真實地理資訊與實測氣象錨定代理模型之訓練，並將全域即時預測、人行路徑熱舒適評估與生成式最佳化整合為可互動之閉環設計決策流程，使系統之產出不僅運算合理，更能直接回應建築師對建築形態與人行路徑之實務設計需求，為氣候調適型都市設計提供應用合理之決策支援。

title: Quantifying the Dynamic Spatial Experience of “Scenes Changing as Steps Move” in Chinese Gardens
title_zh: 園林「步移景異」動態空間體驗之量化研究
abstract_zh:
中國古典園林之「步移景異」，指遊人行於園中，景象隨視點推移而連續變換的動態體驗。此種體驗長期多以文學與現象學語彙描述，難以化為可資客觀比較的資料；既有空間量化工具則多以單一靜止視點為基礎，較少納入遊歷之際前後景象彼此牽動的關係。

本研究將遊園路徑視為連續的時間序列，循量化與描述兩套框架，檢視電腦視覺特徵計算式量化此種體驗之可能與限度。本研究以預訓練的語意分割、深度估計與光流模型，自第一人稱遊園影片萃取六維核心特徵。體驗以兩項獨立的參照刻畫：一為電腦視覺特徵所構成的描述式空間樣貌，二為依預先登記之協議、單一標註者標定的體驗事件。實證涵蓋板橋林家花園、士林雙溪公園與陽明交通大學光復校區三類空間。

量化框架中，依心理學所指之時間尺度、以固定公式寫定前後景象之對比，能穩健改善對體驗強度之判讀，並可推及未曾參與訓練的影片；而由模型自行學習此一對比，於本研究之小樣本規模下並未帶來穩健的助益。增益較可能源於寫入公式的時間尺度，而非模型容量本身。描述框架則以八項描述式特徵刻畫路徑樣貌：其中路徑節奏於揭示密度、語意變動率與深度變動率三項指標上，均見園林類路徑揭示新景之頻率明顯高於校園功能性路徑，且此一對照於擴充至十四支影片後仍維持，與造園論述對敘事節奏之預期一致。此組特徵因不依賴人工標註，得以延伸至第三方跨文化影片，於中國古典園林、日本庭園、西方園林與當代景觀公園之並置中呈現方向一致的對照。綜言之，本研究提出一套銜接現象學描述與運算評估的雙軌框架，並界定此類計算所能與不能捕捉之範圍，可作為傳統園林之數位解讀，及空間設計檢視路徑敘事節奏之一項輔助。

title: Spatial Translation of Emotional Goals: A PAD-Based Emotional Design Rule Library and Assistive Tool for Exhibition Spaces
title_zh: 情緒目標的空間轉譯：基於 PAD 模型之展覽空間情緒規則庫與輔助工具研究
abstract:
Exhibition space design has increasingly shifted from displaying objects to shaping emotional experience, yet how emotional goals correspond to spatial elements largely relies on designers' intuition. Although the PAD emotion model—Pleasure, Arousal, and Dominance—has been applied in environmental psychology and design evaluation, it has mostly served as post-hoc measurement rather than a design input in early planning.

This thesis proposes SPAD (Spatial PAD), a spatial emotion rule library that reframes PAD from post-hoc measurement into an early-stage design input. Through a literature review, ten visual features across four categories—lighting, color, spatial scale, and circulation—were integrated with the three PAD dimensions and classified into four relationship types: positive, negative, inverted-U, and conditional, forming a feature-direction matrix. Function templates and solving logic were designed for each type, addressing cross-dimensional trade-offs, inverted-U branch selection, and feature dependencies, so that PAD targets and weights can be systematically converted into concrete feature levels and descriptive statements, forming a computable, traceable rule library.

To verify the operability of the rule base, this study implemented it as a bidirectional design-support system. The generation tool produces exhibition space visualizations, and comparison with a non-rule-based control group shows that explicit spatial feature guidance helps multiple design alternatives converge toward the same emotional target. The evaluation tool uses the same rule base to estimate PAD coordinates from existing exhibition space images, with its logic examined through feasibility testing and case studies of three exhibition types. SPAD therefore provides an operational framework for translating abstract emotional goals into concrete, literature-based spatial features during the early stages of exhibition space planning.
abstract_zh:
展覽空間設計逐漸從展示物件轉向營造情緒體驗，但情緒目標如何轉化為具體的空間設計元素，實務上仍多仰賴設計者的個人經驗與直覺。既有研究雖已將 PAD 情緒模型，包含愉悅度（Pleasure）、喚醒度（Arousal）與支配度（Dominance），應用於環境心理與設計評估，但多屬事後測量，較少作為規劃前期的設計輸入工具。
 
本研究提出 SPAD（Spatial PAD）空間情緒規則庫，將 PAD 模型由事後測量轉化為前期設計輸入。首先透過文獻回顧，整合光線、色彩、空間尺度與動線四類共十項視覺特徵與 PAD 三維度的關係，依關係型態分為正向、負向、倒 U 型與條件型，建立特徵方向矩陣。接著針對不同關係型態設計對應的函數模板與求解邏輯，處理跨維度加權折衷、倒 U 型候選分支判斷、特徵間依賴計算順序等問題，使使用者輸入之 PAD 目標值與權重，能被系統性轉換為具體的特徵等級與描述語句，形成一套可運算、可回溯的規則庫。
 
為驗證規則庫的可操作性，本研究進一步實作為雙向輔助工具。生成工具串接圖像生成模型產出展覽空間視覺化，與非規則庫對照組比較後，顯示規則庫的具體特徵能使方案穩定收斂於同一組情緒目標。評分工具則以同一規則庫為基準，對既有展覽空間影像回推 PAD 座標，經測試與三類展覽案例驗證確認反推邏輯。研究結果顯示，SPAD 的核心貢獻在於提供一套將抽象情緒目標系統性拆解為具體空間特徵，可回溯至文獻的操作框架，作為展覽空間規劃前期情緒導向設計的基礎。

title: Preliminary Study on the Interlocking Behavior and Stacking Strategies of Geometric Particle Construction
title_zh: 幾何顆粒構築的卡扣行為與堆疊策略初探
abstract: This research investigates the potential of non-convex geometric particles in aggregateconstruction, aiming to establish a systematic classification of stacking strategies and interlocking behavior. Addressing the challenges of assembling geometries without predefined joints, the study is structured into three levels: At the unit level, it introduces Connection Modes and performance indicators such as tolerance and locking capability; at the group level, it identifies stable spatial Cluster types; and at the pile level, it proposes a three-axis framework of stacking control factors—stacking behavior, quantity per action, and particle composition—forming an operational coding system for stacking methods. In practice, controlled simulations using FlexHopper are conducted alongside small-scale physical experiments, including the construction of a triangular arch to validate the system’s feasibility. The outcomes integrate geometric properties, stacking logic, and construction processes, offering a workflow that bridges observation, analysis, and application. This framework is intended to support future research on design-oriented granular construction and stacking strategy development.
abstract_zh:
本研究從幾何設計出發，探討非凸顆粒於聚合構築中的應用潛力，並建構一套可操作的堆疊分類系統與構築策略。針對自由排列、無預設接合方式的幾何構築挑戰，分為三個層級進行分析與實驗：首先於單元層級觀察顆粒間的卡扣關係，提出Connection Mode 與容錯／鎖固性評估方式；再於群體層級歸納出具穩定性與空間特徵的Cluster 類型；最終於大量堆積層級提出「堆疊控制因子」的三軸分類法（堆疊行為、顆粒數量、組成方式），建構可操作、可記錄、可比較的堆疊工法邏輯。
在實作層面，使用FlexHopper 進行控制性模擬，並搭配中小尺度實體堆疊與三角拱構築驗證策略可行性。研究成果整合幾何形態、堆疊邏輯與操作過程，試圖建立一套橫跨觀察、分析與應用的幾何構築流程，提供未來設計導向堆疊操作與顆粒組合規劃的參考架構。

title: T-BAM: Design of a Rigid-Flexible Tensegrity-Based Articulated Manipulator
title_zh: 基於張拉整體結構之剛柔混合關節型機械手臂設計
abstract:
In the fields of contemporary digital fabrication and architectural engineering, there is an increasing focus \textemdash beyond existing robotic construction technologies\textemdash on the development of simplified mechanisms that can adapt to complex and constrained environments. Against this backdrop, rigid-flexible manipulators demonstrate noticeable potential due to their combination of rigidity for load-bearing capacity and flexibility offering high redundancy. This research proposes a rigid-flexible prototype, T-BAM (Tensegrity-Based Articulated Manipulator), based on a multi-layer tensegrity structure. Leveraging the parametric nature of such structures, the study further establishes a unified parametric simulator integrating structural design, physics-based simulation, and control system.
This research is inspired by the biomimetic design of vertebrates and approaches the topic from a geometric perspective, parameterizing the multi-layer tensegrity structure into a computational model. After analyzing its mechanical behavior, the structure is further transformed into a manipulator design and realized through robot implementation. Its motion patterns and configurations under external forces are described through kinematic and mathematical models.
With regard to kinematic performance, experimental results indicate that each module of T-BAM exhibits 4-DOF: bending (two axes), torsion, and contraction-extension. This module is capable of achieving a maximum bending angle of $90^\circ$, an umbrella-shaped range of motions, an axial extension ratio of $14\%$, and a load capacity of 0.2 kg. Furthermore, the research utilizes machine learning and evolutionary algorithms to optimize the control system and mathematical model respectively. The results demonstrate that the proposed optimization framework effectively reduces the deviation between predicted and actual configurations.
abstract_zh:
當代數位製造與建築工程領域在既有機器人輔助建造技術的基礎上，更積極探索能夠以簡化機構適應複雜、限制性環境等特定作業條件之設計與系統開發。剛柔混合機械手臂在此背景之下，因其具備剛性之荷重能力以及柔性之高冗餘自由度，而能勝任此類涉及環境探索兼精密操控之任務。對此，本研究以複層張拉整體結構為基礎，試圖藉由此種結構可參數化之特性，提出一種剛柔混合之原型(T-BAM)，以及整合其結構設計、物理模擬與控制系統三者之參數化模擬器。
本研究以脊椎動物為仿生設計之啟發，由幾何構成切入，將複層張拉整體結構量化為參數模型。在分析其受力行為後，進一步轉化為機械手臂設計與實體模型，並以運動學、數學模型描述其受外力作用下之運動模式與姿態。
針對其運動表現，實驗結果顯示：此機械手臂之單位模矩具備四軸之自由度，分別為側向彎曲（兩軸）、軸向扭轉以及軸向伸縮；同時可達成$90^\circ$之最大彎曲角度、傘型之活動範圍、$14\%$之軸向伸縮比例、0.2公斤之荷重能力。 此外，本研究也分別利用機器學習與遺傳演算法，針對控制系統及數學模型進行最佳化，結果顯示此架構能有效降低實際與預測姿態間之誤差。

title: Development and Applications of an Interactive Pneumatic System Design Tool
title_zh: 互動式氣動系統設計工具之開發與應用
abstract:
Pneumatic technology is widely applied across various fields, from engineering, robotics, and architecture to medical devices and everyday products. In the context of pneumatic design applications, designers focus on integrating spaces, structures, pneumatic systems, and interactive scenarios. Utilizing the deformation or motion of pneumatic structures helps achieve design objectives. However, current design tools in the design field often lack support for pneumatic technology.
In this research, we developed an interactive pneumatic system design tool based on the modeling software Rhino and Grasshopper, assisting designers in planning and integrating pneumatic systems within a familiar software environment. This tool endows 3D models with the operational mechanisms of pneumatic systems, enabling system and 3D scene interaction and visualization, allowing users to integrate pneumatic systems while designing devices. By integrating software tools and workflows, the research aims to enhance the rapid iteration and potential of pneumatic technology in design applications.
Finally, the usage process and functionalities were validated through four case studies that utilized this pneumatic system design tool for development, integration, and teaching. To bridge the gap between different fields of expertise and knowledge, this research aimed to lower the application threshold of pneumatic technology in design by developing and integrating the design tool. This allows users to explore pneumatic systems and address the ever-changing, integrative, and innovative demands of design.
abstract_zh:
從工程、機器人、建築、醫療到日常用品，氣動技術在各個領域中被廣泛應用。在設計領域的氣動應用中，設計師注重於空間、結構、氣動系統和互動場景的設計整合，利用氣動結構的變形或運動來達成設計目標。然而，目前設計領域的設計工具大部分缺乏氣動技術的資源。
本研究開發了基於建模軟體Rhino和Grasshopper的互動式氣動系統設計工具，協助設計師在熟悉的軟體環境中規劃和整合氣動系統。本研究提出之設計工具提供與實體氣動零件對應的參數化元件，使用者可以在設計裝置的同時整合氣動系統，賦予3D模型氣動系統的運作機制，以進行系統與場景的互動和視覺化。透過整合軟體工具和工作流程來提升氣動技術在設計應用中的快速迭代和可能性。
最後，透過四個以此氣動系統設計工具輔助開發、整合與教學的案例來驗證使用流程以及功能。為了跨越不同領域的專業技術和知識，本研究透過開發與整合設計工具來降低氣動技術在設計中的應用門檻，讓使用者能夠探索氣動系統，並應對不斷變化、整合和創新的設計需求。

title: A Sentient Space Having Exploratory Behaviour Using Light Sensing
title_zh: 具備自主探索行為的光感知空間
abstract:
This thesis aims to depict space as an entity capable of perception and to establish adaptive behavior based on light perception. In nature, organisms uniquely perceive their surroundings and respond to dynamic environments through exploratory behaviors, with some actively probing their environment using their own energy. In contrast to the passive reception of ambient light by humans, this method allows for more effective responses to unknown environment.

In today's smart buildings, the focus is on solving societal issues pragmatically, yet these buildings remain unaware of surrounding data flows. If space could respond to environmental dynamics through external forces, human-computer interaction could advance towards empathetic responses to variable situations and challenges.

This research proposes a prototype spatial system using projected light environments to present lightweight light perception. Utilizing particle algorithms, it constructs adaptive exploratory behavior regarding space's motion state and environmental characteristics. By demonstrating active exploratory behavior towards light environment dynamics, this study showcases the concept of space possessing perceptual and responsive capabilities.
abstract_zh: 本論文旨在將空間描繪為一個具有感知能力的實體，並建立基於光感知的空間自適應行為。在自然界中，各種生物以獨特方式感知周遭環境，並透過探索行為應對動態環境。其中，某些生物透過自身能量進行主動地探測環境，不同於人類依賴環境光線的被動接收，這種方式能更有效地應對未知或複雜的環境變化。當空間處於現今相對飽和的計算環境中，智慧建築的概念導向實用主義，意圖積極地解決人類社會中的各種問題，而它仍對於其周遭的數據流動沒有意識。因此，若有一種方法可以透由環境與外在的力量，賦予空間對於環境動態的反應能力，將能讓人機互動的發展朝向共感的概念以應對多變的情境與環境挑戰。因此本研究基於投影的光環境空間作為系統應用的原型設計，提出空間輕量化的光線感知，透過粒子演算的運動模式，建構出空間對自身運動狀態與環境特徵的自適應探索行為。透過空間對於光環境動態的主動探索行為，呈現了空間具備感知能力與反應的概念表現。

title: Exploring Stylization Methods and Tools for Non-Uniform Point Clouds
title_zh: 探索非均質點雲的表現法與風格設計工具
abstract:
Advancements in point cloud technology now allow mobile device users to scan and generate real-time 3D models of scenes, spaces, and objects, expanding their use in design and creative projects. However, point clouds still lack effective stylization tools, primarily due to the requirement for highly precise and dense point clouds to reconstruct continuous surface details similar to mesh models, which depend on specialized equipment and software.
This research highlights the potential of the 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) technique. 3DGS replaces traditional point clouds with semi-transparent Gaussian ellipsoids, simulating blurry strokes and creating realistic visual effects with fewer points. Unlike traditional methods focused on geometric precision, 3DGS achieves visual effects through the distribution of strokes, akin to human painting techniques.
Inspired by brushwork art, this study developed a stylization system for 3DGS, proposing methods to process non-homogeneous point clouds for controlled point distribution and transforming points into parametric strokes. These methods were implemented in modeling software, enabling users to design styles by combining strokes through point distribution control. The study also explored integrating Gaussian ellipsoids with parametric strokes, using pointillism to demonstrate this approach's potential. This research expands the possibilities for digital creativity using point clouds by exploring a new representation and design tools.
abstract_zh: 點雲的技術日新月異，如今人們可以使用行動裝置掃描場景、空間和物件，即時取得三維物體的點雲模型，因此，點雲在設計與創作的應用也越來越廣泛。然而，與網格模型相比，目前缺乏有效的風格化工具來探索點雲表現法。這是因為點雲風格化要求高幾何精度的密集點雲以重建如網格模型的連續性表面資訊。但密集點雲的取得、計算與編輯仍需要仰賴專業設備與專用軟體。本研究觀察到最新的高斯潑濺技術提供了新的切入點。高斯潑濺使用半透明高斯橢球代替傳統點雲，模擬在空間中潑撒模糊筆觸的效果，使用較少的點即可還原逼真的視覺效果。高斯潑濺並不注重描述模型表面的幾何精度，而是透過分布不同的筆觸來達到視覺效果，這與人類繪畫的原理有異曲同工之妙。基於此觀點，相較於傳統需要高密度點雲的風格化方法，本研究開發了適合高斯潑濺的風格化系統。首先，提出了處理非均質點雲的方法，以控制點雲分布；同時，設計了將點轉換為參數化筆觸的方法。並將兩者應用於建模軟體中實作風格化系統，使創作者可以透過控制點雲分布來組合不同筆觸進行風格設計。最後，以點描法為例，探索了混搭高斯橢球與參數化筆觸的風格化方法。本研究探索了一種基於新幾何媒介的表現方法與設計工具，拓展了以點雲進行數位創作的可能性。

title: A New Approach to Form Generation: Information Paths through Textualized Form Space
title_zh: 從資訊路徑的觀點看形式生成：文本化的形式空間
abstract:
Information science has become an indispensable element across all fields. New information technologies catalyze the development of innovative techniques for managing and using knowledge. Since Italian architect Luigi Moretti's coining of the term "parametric architecture," humanity has witnessed remarkable advancements in human-computer interaction modes and CAD/CAM tools, fundamentally reshaping the way architects work. With the flourishing development of parametric modeling softwares, as more parameters are defined and integrated, the number of potential design outcomes proliferates, leading to information overload of forms. To address the complexity of form-derived information, efficiently managing this vast amount of data becomes a critical concern.

Taking metaphorical use of space as a means of conceptualizing information, namely where numerous information reside could be regarded as a vast space and the trail navigating through the space to find information could be seen as an information path. This study investigates the potential of information paths as a form generation strategy within the form space. The act of creation involves defining of form space, as well as navigating through it. Movements within form space is equivalent to form generation. 

To facilitate data computation and management, the ideas of dimensionalization, numericalization and textualization are introduced to parameterized forms. Data of forms is stored in textual format to make it computable, editable, and retrievable. Form text captures parametric values of forms, while generation text documents the form generation process. Combining the concept of form space (to define forms) and form generation space (to computate movements within form space), the proposed Grasshopper-based form generation system prototype includes the processes of form generation, documentation, retrieval, and regeneration, and highlights the significance of systematic and automated information workflow.
abstract_zh:
當代所有學科的發展都離不開對資訊學的討論，新的資訊科技促成了特定領域中嶄新的知識管理和運用技術的發展。自義大利建築師Luigi Moretti定義「參數建築」以來，人機互動的模式和電腦輔助設計與製造工具日新月異，建築師的工作型態也隨著工具的革新產生了劇烈的變化。參數式建模軟體蓬勃發展，可能的設計結果隨著更多的參數被界定和整合而增加，導致形式版本的資訊超載。因應形式生成過程所衍生的龐雜資訊，如何有效地管理巨量的形式資訊是不可迴避的課題。

本研究將資訊的概念加以空間化，亦即，將眾多資訊所在之處視為一廣大的空間，「資訊路徑」可視為在資訊空間中尋找到特定資訊所需要的定位和移動的策略，及穿越此空間時所形成的軌跡。在此空間隱喻下，本研究旨在探討資訊路徑在形式空間中作為形式生成策略的可能性——由N項形式參數所定義的參數模型即是一個N維的形式空間，設計創造的行為不只是形式空間的定義，也包括探索這個空間、遇見特定形式的過程。在形式空間中的移動即是生成。

本研究提出將參數化的形式資訊與生成資訊加以空間維度化、數值化和文本化的方法，以利形式生成的資訊運算與管理——將形式資訊以形式文本的型態儲存，使其可被運算、並易於編輯及提取；生成文本則記錄生成的過程。結合「形式空間」（定義形式）和「形式生成參數空間」（運算形式在形式空間中的位移）的概念，以Grasshopper為開發環境的形式生成與資料管理系統原型納入了形式的生成、記錄、重返與再生成等流程，期能突顯系統化、自動化的資訊管理對當代形式生成系統的重要性。

title: Parametric Modelling and Geometric Design of Bistable Deployable Scissor Structures Consisting of Translational Units Based on Flat Retraction Logic
title_zh: 基於扁平收縮邏輯的雙穩態可展開平移剪刀系統之幾何設計與參數化模擬
keywords_zh: 雙穩態可展開剪刀結構
abstract:
Nowadays, architecture tectonics are no longer limited to steady structures and long-lasting materials like cement and bricks. Temporary or ephemeral architectures using flexible and deployable structures emerge for various applications. For example, The shed of Diller Scofidio + Renfro, Hoberman’s Iris Dome, and Stretch Design’s Sandstone X. These mechanisms are beneficial to the rapid construction of space.
The subject of this research is the study of the retraction change mode and geometric designs of deployable scissor grids based on the Hoberman mechanism.
The retraction logic of this type of flat mechanism can be changed mainly by moving the pivot point of the rod and using bistable deployable scissor structures consisting of translational units. The bistable deployable structures are used to change the retraction logic. By accurately adjusting the rod length of the scissor module, the mechanism has a variety of shapes under the flat retraction logic. It allows a high degree of design freedom.
Therefore, the mechanism can remain flat while it retracts, and the irregular translational units allow for a greater variety of surface variations in the shape of the mechanism. Through the study of the scissor system, a simplified mathematical model is used to explore the geometric potential, and a formula for complete flat retraction is derived. We use Grasshopper in Rhino as a parameterization platform. By the geometric conclusion of the proven formula, the logic of the generation between the modules is organized. Firstly, we used C# script language to generate the rods of the mechanism and Kangaroo for dynamic simulation. Secondly, the parameters of the change in the shape of each unit in each row are adjusted so that the shape of the mechanism can be adjusted to form different deployable structures. The mechanism can adjust the shape of the bar in the X-Y plane, and then the design of the bar shape is adjusted to produce different blocking effects by studying the actual application.
The research provides a unique retraction mode for deployable scissor grids, thus facilitating the collection and transportation of such mechanisms in practical applications. As a result, irregular Deployable Scissor Structures are created that can retract from 3D to 2D while adjusting the rod with different masking effects and can be quickly generated by adjusting the parameters and curvature of the curve.
abstract_zh:
隨著社會的發展，開始出現大量的臨時建築，建築不再侷限於水泥等長時效性建構方式，能夠在短期內構建的臨時建築開始大量出現。例如，Diller Scofidio + Renfro的The shed，Hoberman的Iris Dome，以及Stretch Design的Sandstone X，這些機制都有利於空間的快速建構。
本研究主題是研究以Hoberman Mechanism為基礎的剪刀結構的收縮變化方式。為了能夠讓這類機構具有更豐富的造型變化，並改變這類機構的壓縮邏輯，讓它擁有更大的收縮率。
剪刀結構的收縮邏輯主要通過移動桿件的樞軸點和使用由平移剪刀單元組成的雙穩態可展開剪刀結構進行改變。通過精確調整剪刀模塊的桿長，使得該機構能夠在扁平壓縮邏輯下具有各種形狀，不規則的剪刀單元使得機構的形狀具有高設計自由度。
通過對剪刀系統的研究，我們用一個簡化的數學模型來探索剪刀結構的幾何潛力，並推導出一個扁平收縮邏輯的公式。再利用Rhino中的Grasshopper作為模擬的參數化平臺，借由經過驗證的公式的幾何結論，對機構模塊之間的生成邏輯進行整理，經C# script程式語言演算法生成與Kangaroo動態模擬，通過調整每一排單元形態的變動參數，從而調整機構的形狀，形成不同可展開伸縮面。並根據該機構可以在X-Y平面上調整桿件形狀的的特性，通過對實際應用的探討，調整桿件形狀的設計，產生不同遮蔽性效果。
本研究為可展開剪刀網提供了一種獨特的縮回模式，有利於實際應用中這種機制的收納和運輸。最終，本研究通過數位的方式模擬扁平剪刀係統的動態效果，並可自由調整參數快速生成適應多種曲線、不同遮蔽效果的不規則扁平可展開剪刀結構。

title: A Proof of Concept for Exploring Graduated Research Landscape using Co-occurrence Analysis and Focus+Context Visualization
title_zh: 以共現分析與焦點上下文視覺化探索研究主題地景之概念驗證
abstract:
Theses and dissertations, as a means to accumulate and deliver concepts, innovations, and implementations, are the main building blocks of the research institute, especially the creative learning organization. This research takes applied knowledge base of the digital architecture program as an example, where young researchers often derive their theses from unfamiliar and multi-disciplinary topics.
The query-based approach in the literature retrieval system is difficult to display complex structures and related concepts within a domain, and is insufficient when researchers find it hard to express the vague information needs in a phrase with limited terms. Bibliometric analysis provides an efficient framework for exploring the structural aspects of scientific knowledge. While many focus on systematic reviews of large-volume scientific data, few conduct in-depth analysis for graduate studies and limit the interactivity of visualization, making it difficult for students to respond with dynamic behaviors.
This paper aims to provide another perspective to explore the thematic map of the knowledge generated in theses with the integration of science mapping analysis, exploratory behaviors, and visualizing workflow. To validate the concept, the interactive dashboard with focus+context visualization is developed as a prototype to support wayfinding in research topics.
In this study, we extract terms from 95 design research theses in an applied knowledge base of creative institution between 2002 to 2022, and perform automated data pre-processing to apply the co-occurrence analysis for creating thematic clusters. We present a design framework around three abstract processes to design the interactive visualization for exploring multivariate information based on top-down and bottom-up perspectives. The results reveal that digital media-oriented theses papers cover 4 main topics and highlight the shifting pattern of the research interest. The integrated workflow can be applied to different academic works, such as syllabus, projects, given the possibility to expand the knowledge and explore a more comprehensive graduated research landscape in the future.
abstract_zh:
對創意型學習機構，其碩博士論文，因整合不同領域概念、發展變化、創新應用，是學術發展的核心基礎。本研究以數位建築領域為例，討論學生在探索陌生的跨學科概念，面臨知識整合上的挑戰，如：歸納相似的研究主題、評估學術指標與發展、找到適合的研究方向等。而透過既有碩博士論文系統查閱相關學術文獻，仍需花大量時間從條列的檢索結果中組織論文重點，無法有效理解該領域之脈絡。因此，如何有效解讀資料以及整合不同領域的概念來完成研究論文，成為學生重要的課題。文獻計量學（bibliometrics）提供科學的方法解釋學術網路，然而多數以大數據分析專業領域之整體研究趨勢，較少應用於小型研究機構管理跨領域學術論文，且提供學生探尋局部關聯的資訊環境；此外，複雜的分析流程也侷限圖表之互動性，難以因應動態的探尋行為與資訊需求。
本研究旨在整合資料處理、探尋行為、視覺架構，搭建互動介面來驗證概念，提供使用者另一種角度探索多元研究領域。本研究預提出適合研究所的科學圖譜分析（science mapping analysis）流程，並借用空間尋路（wayfinding）的資訊編排與焦點上下文（focus+context）的互動呈現，設計論文主題資訊地景。本研究從建築研究所自 2002-2022 年數位組中，篩選 95 筆碩士畢業論文。透過自動化與半自動化的資料預處理，進行論文格式與字詞上的調整，以利共現分析（co-occurrence analysis）取得較為精確之集群結果，再將結果進行視覺編碼，以及轉譯資訊需求為視覺語言，最終產生論文主題地圖。本研究將整個設計流程歸納為三個抽象層級之架構，涵蓋資料、資訊探尋任務、以及資訊視覺化，並以整合性工作流程系統性地建構互動式資訊儀表板，輔助使用者以不同路徑，探尋多變量論文網路（multivariate network）。
本研究期望發展出適合創意型研究機構之「文獻資料處理、分析、視覺化工作流程」，透過此流程，本研究發現研究所之設計論文涵蓋四個主要議題，以及近年有明顯的領域轉移。此外，本研究也以三種任務情境，示範使用者探尋論文可能的操作過程，以此提供後續設計優化之建議。本研究之設計系統將延伸應用於其他學術成果文本分析，如課程、設計作品等資訊，擴展更為全面的學術地景（research landscape），協助學生、專業者、管理者，用不同角度探索、管理，與應用學術研究，挖掘更豐富的學術知識。

title: A Natural Human-Drone Interface for Spatial Presence Experience
title_zh: 以無人機自然使用介面打造遠端空間臨場體驗
abstract:
With the wave of remote work and labor shortages, it is inevitable that construction-related industries must reduce their labor and transportation costs as much as possible. With urban expansion and globalization, remote construction has become the norm, and remote project management has become an important issue. Inspired by drone technology and Telepresence robot, this study attempts to use drone technology to replace the human eye to make remote construction monitoring more convenient and freer. Unlike the static view angle of previous cameras, remote site monitoring through drones will provide the viewer with the ability to actively control the view angle and the immersive experience of being there, which will facilitate more accurate and precise spatial viewing, monitoring, and management applications. Current drone control still relies on the pilot to control the drone through the flight joystick, which has reduced a lot of time and brought positive assistance to the industry, but the pilot must still be present to control the drone. In addition, the drone has a certain technical threshold, and non-professional pilots need to go through a period of familiarization, training, and examination to reach the practical application level.
To address these issues, and considering that there are still a lot of limitations in drone flight testing in terms of regulations and safety considerations, this study builds a drone simulator to simulate a realistic drone configuration and flight environment. We also developed a drone control interface that integrates voice recognition technology and body posture recognition technology to allow pilots to interact with the drone easily. In addition to the intuitive interactive interface, a VR helmet and an airbag vest were integrated to provide a multi-sensory environment perception for the pilots with a spatial presence experience. Finally, user tests were conducted on nine participants, who indicated that the system successfully provided pilots with a remote spatial experience. Although drone control still needs to be optimized, this study has great potential for non-professional pilots to perform remote monitoring and exploration.
abstract_zh:
在遠距工作與缺工的浪潮下，建築相關行業無可避免的必須盡可能減少相關人力及交 通成本。且伴隨著都市擴張以及全球化影響，遠距建設已成為常態，遠端專案管理也成為重要課題。受到無人機技術與遠端臨場機器人 (Telepresence robot) 啟發，同時 為了使遠端營建監控能夠更方便與自由，本研究試圖利用無人機科技來代替人眼進行 遠端監控。有別於以往攝影機的靜態視角，透過無人機進行遠端基地監控將有機會帶給觀看者主動控制視角的能力以及身歷其境的沈浸感受，其將有助於進行更確實、準確的空間觀看、監測、管理之應用。而當前之無人機操控仍需仰賴飛手在現場透過飛行搖桿控制，此技術雖已能減少大量時間且帶來正向輔助，但飛手仍必須到場操控。不僅於此，無人機具備一定之技術門檻限制，非專業飛手需經過一段時間養成、培訓、考試才能達到實際應用水平。
為了回應以上問題，同時考量到無人機飛行測試目前在法規與安全考量上仍存在諸多限制，本研究打造了一無人機測試系統來模擬無人機真實配置與飛行環境。同時開發了整合語音辨識技術與身體姿態辨識技術開的無人機控制介面，讓飛手能輕鬆地與無人機互動。除了直覺的互動介面外，為了提供使用者身歷其境的空間感受，本研究也整合了 VR 頭盔以及氣囊背心以提供飛手多感官的環境感知。最後，本文對 9 位受測者 進行使用者測試，其表示此系統成功地提供飛手遠端空間的臨場體驗，雖然無人機控制尚需優化，但此研究對於遠端監控、探索有巨大潛力。

title: Exploring the Topological System of Wood Structure and Knowledge Map - Taking Dougong as an Example
title_zh: 探索木結構拓撲系統與知識地圖-以斗拱為例
abstract:
The traditional large-span timber structure engineering adopts a precise tenon-and-mortise system, which overcomes the limitation of material size. However, under the complex structural composition, how to carry out clear lofting and knowledge transfer are important issues. This research will take “Dougong” as an example to analyze the topological relationship between the various wooden components and develop a graphical representation of the complex wood tenon joint system. This study chooses Rhino 7/Grasshopper3D as the main platform for deriving topological shapes, which will speed up the discussion of geometry and the relationship between parameters. In the process of this research, I use Dougong to present a series of knowledge graphs.
In the process of Dougong analysis, this study developed a set of automatic sorting and classification methods for Dougong’s geometric features, which apply to various Dougong types. Then, this research developed a visual knowledge graph of the relationship between Dougong components and extended the Syntactic digital tool from the spatial application of Space Syntax to a wooden structure system such as Dougong. By analyzing the visual graphics of the complex wood structure system. This study found that the structural relationship of the traditional Dougong is close to the branch system of the L-System. But it has the characteristics of a horizontal connection, which makes the mutual tenon joint between the Dougong components. Besides traditional wooden structure analysis and automatic geometric calculation, this study also extends the application of Dougong, including information conversion between computers, to expand the flow of Dougong between various software. There are Dougong’s features for modeling evolution. The generation of a timber frame system applied to parametric Dougong breaks through the limitations of the existing traditional framework. This paper used the extension kit Wasp for derivative discrete modeling, providing possible future discrete modularization of Dougong.
Through the above, topological exploration and extended application for Dougong. Not only to providing a set of observation and application viewpoints for Dougong, but also help to develop its perceptual elements, and accommodate the history of humanities, society, and real-world factors such as mathematics and gravity in science.
abstract_zh:
傳統的大跨度木結構工程採用精密的榫卯系統，克服了材料尺寸的限制，然而，在複雜的結構組成下，如何進行清晰的放樣和知識轉移都是重要的課題。本研究會以“斗拱”為例，分析各木部件相互間的拓撲關係並開發複雜木榫接系統的圖形表示。本研究選擇 Rhino 7/Grasshopper3D 作為推導拓撲形狀的主要平檯，這將加速幾何討論和參數相互之間的關係。通過本研究的流程，本研究利用斗拱，呈現了一系列的知識地圖。
於斗拱分析過程中，本研究開發了一套針對斗拱幾何特徵進行的自動排序和分類方法，並適用於各類斗拱類型。然後，本研究生成了斗拱部件之間關係的可視化知識地圖，並將Syntactic 數位工具從空間句法（Space Syntax）的空間應用拓展到斗拱這樣地木結構系統上。透過分析複雜木結構系統後的可視化圖形，本研究發現傳統斗拱的結構關係接近L-System的分支系統，但它具有橫向連接的特點，使斗拱間的相互榫接更加牢固。除了傳統木結構分析和自動化的幾何計算之外，本研究也同時延伸斗拱的應用，包含計算機間的資訊轉換，企圖擴展斗拱於各軟體間的串流；探索斗拱幾何型態的，企圖依循既有斗拱特徵進行造型演化；應用於參數化斗拱的木構架系統生成，突破既有傳統構架方正的局限性；利用擴展套件Wasp進行衍生式離散建模，提供斗拱未來可能的離散模矩化。
透過上述針對斗拱的拓撲探索與擴展應用，除了能提供一套斗拱的觀察與應用觀點，亦有助於開拓其感性元素，同時地包容人文方面的歷史、社會，以及科學方面的數學與重力等現實因素。

title: An Exploration of Technobiophilic Design — The Micro Motion of Dappled Light
title_zh: 數位親生物設計探索—以葉隙光斑為例
abstract:
Biophilia hypothesis was devised by Edward O. Wilson(1984), being based on evolutionary psychology, which suggests that "people have the innate tendency to focus on life and lifelike processes". So far, the development of the theory has been invested in many different fields, which proves that it is helpful for human physical and mental health. It has also attracted attention in the field of architecture and interior. The mainstream is the planning and configuration of "actual natural" such as the introduction of natural light, vegetation walls, and plant decorations. In recent years, facing the development of information technology and the Internet of Things, people have become inseparable from their digital lives. It seems push you and me farther away from the nature. Excessive Internet dependence and addiction have caused people to become detached from the real environment and cause mental illness. However, can Biophilia return to our lives through digital technology? Sue Thomas (2013) devised a concept of "Technobiophilia", which is "the innate tendency to focus on life and lifelike processes as they appear in technology".

Digital technology can be resistance or assistance while facing biophilia .This study is based on the above review and sums up that how technobiophilic design coexists indoor and awakens the impression of people's perception of the ambient environment. And through the design research and prototype making for the micro motion of dappled light, this study explores the distance and relationship between nature and people .
abstract_zh:
Biophilia hypothesis由Edward O. Wilson於1984年提出，以進化心理學為基礎，說明「人們具有親近自然或人造生命形式的天生傾向」，發展至今已有許多不同領域的研究投入，證明其對於人生理與心理健康具有幫助。它也引起了建築和室內領域的關注，並成為國際健康建築指標the WELL Building Standard重點項目。目前主流探討多為「實際自然」的規劃與應用策略，例如引入自然光、植被牆和植物裝飾。近年來，面對資訊技術與物聯網的發展，人們已脫離不了數位生活，這似乎是將我們與自然的距離推離得更遠。對網路世界的過度依賴和沈迷使人們與真實環境脫節並引起精神疾病。然而，Biophilia是否能藉由數位技術回歸我們生活？Sue Thomas 於2013年提出Technobiophilia，說明「人們具有親近以數位技術呈現之自然或人造生命的天生傾向」。

數位技術的發展在面對biophilic理念，可以是阻力也可以是助力，本研究綜合以上回顧，以Technobiophilia與恢復性環境為研究基礎，總結數位親生物設計如何在室內共存並喚醒人們對於周邊環境感知的印象。透過仿葉隙光斑微動態空間裝置，探討不同數位擬真程度帶來真實感與親生物療癒感的關聯性，以了解自然與人的距離。

title: Point Cloud Processing and Form Derivation by Using Multidimensional Information
title_zh: 運用多維資訊進行點雲處理與造型演化
abstract:
In the era of three-dimensional informatics, the rapid development of computational design and digital manufacturing has facilitated the design of complex geometric and organic structures. At the same time, it also unlocks the potential of design from 3D to higher dimensional space. However, current mainstream design procedures are still to define the XYZ space relation before material assignments. These procedures exhibit limitations in both connections between architectures and spatial structures and product aesthetics in industrial design. In virtue of great advances in photogrammetry and 3D scanning, point clouds are essentially ideal data sources for data-driven modeling as they can realize storage of high dimensional data (e.g., time, color, intensity) and are independent from each other.

In this study, data points, which are fundamental geometric constituent elements in 3D space, were employed to drive design so that designers can work in the familiar visual modeling platform (Rhino/Grasshopper). Through the point cloud processing procedures and components established in this study, the existing high-dimensional space materials in the real world are integrated with the geometric structure of the point cloud. And through the analysis and extraction of Eigen Vector and Eigen Color, the form evolution process of the target object can be applied.
abstract_zh: 在三維資訊時代下，運算式設計與數位製造的快速發展使複雜幾何、有機結構等造型設計得到解放，同時也提供了從三維到更高維度空間設計的發展潛力，但至今的設計流程仍是以先定義ＸＹＺ空間關係再賦予材質為主流，此流程不論是對於建築與空間涵構關係的連結，還是對工業設計中產品美感的考量仍有其限制。然而，在攝影測量與三維掃描等技術成熟發展下，「點雲」此種能夠儲存高維度數據（如：時間、顏色、強度等）同時又彼此獨立互不影響的原數據是資料驅動建模（Data-Driven Modeling）較佳的參數來源，因此本研究企圖用三維幾何構成元素中最底層的數據 ──「點」來驅動設計，同時使設計者能在熟悉的視覺化建模平台（Rhino/Grasshopper）中，透過本研究所建立之點雲處理流程與元件，將現實世界既存的高維度空間素材以點雲進行整合，並經由特徵向量（Eigen Vector）與特徵顏色（Eigen Color）之分析與提取，應用至目標對象的造型演化流程中。

title: Spatial Chladni: Representation Sound in 3D
title_zh: Chladni的空間再現:從聲音切片到三維表現法呈現
abstract: This study was based on Chladni Figures and tried to spatially extend its representation of sound. The current Chladni Figures only see parts of the sound. There should be more spatial representation of sounds because they are transmitted in our surroundings. This study aimed to explore how to capture and reconstruct invisible sound information to create three-dimensional forms. A series of steps were taken to record Chladni Figures of different frequencies and decibels. First, Pure Data was adopted to generate different frequencies and decibels. Then Grasshopper was used to capture Chladni Figures and then the figures were converted into point clouds. Finally, these point clouds were processed by using different algorithms to produce layers of superimposed state from which 3D forms of sound can be generated and fabricated. The results showed that sounds not only stayed at the level of hearing, but could also be seen, touched, and reinterpreted spatially. With the spatial forms of sound, viewers no longer perceive sound through single but multiple states. This can help us conceive sound in a vast variety of ways. The main contribution to the field and the limitation of this study will be also further explained and discussed.
abstract_zh: Chladni Figures的視覺化呈現大多僅限於2D成像的部分，本研究試圖在空間上擴展聲音表現的可能性，因為聲音在空間中的傳播是三維的，它需要能夠展現出更多的空間表現形式。本研究著重於捕獲和重建不可見的聲音信息並將其創建三維形式。以一系列的實驗步驟來記錄不同頻率和分貝的Chladni Figures，使用軟體Pure Data產生聲音，並將所實驗Chladni Figures的影像匯入電腦軟體Grasshopper中轉化為點雲的狀態，再以不同的演算法處理所生成的點雲，試圖在不同維度下疊加與生成，並製作出3D形式的聲音樣貌。通過這一連串處理和表示聲音的方法，讓聲音不僅僅只停留在聽覺上，更加可以在空間上看到、觸摸和再現。建構聲音從2D到3D的可視化過程，讓觀看者不再只是通過單一聽覺的方式接收聲音，而是能以多重的狀態感知聲音的實體，這可以幫助我們以多種方式去構想聲音。目前對於此領域的主要貢獻和局限性，也會在最後結論做進一步的解釋和討論。

title: Jewelry as Micro Architecture
title_zh: 珠寶是微型建築
abstract:
Computer-aided design (CAD) and digital media fabrication are currently fully fledged in architecture and other design fields. New tools, including building information modeling, generative design and parametric design, have been developed to meet various demands. These developments, in turn, brought out novel design thinking, which leads to new CAD applications and facilitates workflow.

Jewelry and architecture, having significant scale differences, are two seemingly unrelated domains. However, jewelry can be related and recognized as micro-architectures based on their cross-domain design experiences, shared operating methods, needs of communication, the common design elements, and structural approaches. This study attempted to establish the linkage of design concepts between these two domains. We explored the possibility of whether jewelry design could adopt the architectural experiences that would inspire and solve the existing problems and open up a new venue of the design works.

The present work was carried out in two stages. First, the current status and the advantage/disadvantage of the computer-aided jewelry design were evaluated. By applying the concept of parametric design, the jewelry design was deconstructed into small components, followed by analyses and systemized induction, a parametric design principle was established, which was evaluated for its feasibility in jewelry design. In the second stage, a parametric design tool was proposed and applied to jewelry design and its manufacturing.

The results from this study reinforce the core concept that Jewelry can be viewed as Micro Architecture, and suggest the applicability and benefit of parametric methodology in jewelry design.
abstract_zh:
電腦輔助設計製造以及數位媒材於現今已成熟的運用在建築等設計領域。因應需求而生的新型態工具包含建築資訊模型、衍伸式設計以及參數式設計。藉由參數式設計，產生新的設計方式，帶動了有別以往的工作流程及更多輔助設計應用的新可能性。

珠寶與建築兩個看似沒有關係且尺度相差甚遠的兩個領域。但藉由跨領域設計經驗、工作模式、溝通需求、設計元素以及結構工法的觀點，珠寶可以類比為一種微型建築。本研究試圖藉由文獻與案例，更深的連結珠寶是微建築的核心概念，進而探討珠寶設計是否能取建築之經驗，啟發解決現有的問題以開創新的可能性?

本研究分為二個階段：首先為電腦輔助應用於珠寶設計之優劣勢與現況分析，以參數式思維將珠寶設計解構、分析、系統化歸納並建立參數式珠寶工具以討論其可行性與可能性；第二階段則提出參數式設計工具輔助設計與製造流程並探討參數式工具輔助珠寶設計於未來數位構築之應用。

本研究結果顯示珠寶可視為一種微型建築，並驗證了數位製造與參數式設計應用於珠寶領域的可行性與其裨益。

title: The Research and Applications of WirePrint in Multiple Materials
title_zh: 非沉積線列印材料工法之研究及應用
keywords_zh: 同軸擠出工具頭及工法開發
abstract:
Today's three-dimensional printing machines (RepRap, 3D printer), which are common in industry to people's livelihood, use FDM (Fused Deposition Modeling) technology mainly. This technology is widely used in the design. However, because of the printing restrictions of equipment and materials, it can often only be used as a prototype proofing, and lacks more design applications.

Wireprint is a better printing method which partially improves the shortcomings of FDM, reduces material and time costs, increases the variety of materials and corresponding implements, and has more opportunities for design applications in the manufacturing process. The purpose of this study is to develop a method for efficiently generating the line segments and paths in three-dimensional space, and to convert a digital model into a G-code for a 3D printer and robotic arms by using parametric software (Grasshopper) simply, manufactured with a variety of material experiments and tool designs.

The research is mainly divided into three parts. The first is about the method of parameterizing the generated paths and the conversion of g-code to the wireprint.; the second is to parameterize and optimize the G-code generated process flow, and then transfer it to digital machine manufacturing, such as 3D printing. Tools such as a watch machine. The third is to try to use different media and different tools to record the experimental and research process of parametric path manufacturing, and to discuss the summary and future application of this technology.

During the research, using the 3D printing machine and six-axis robotic arm to do Wireprint experiments, through several experiments such as clay materials, thermoplastic materials and composite materials. The combination of materials and manufacturing technology silk molding method, make architects and designer more capability research and develop on works and construction method in the future.

The importance of this research is that with a simple parametric editing software, you can manipulate the 3D printer or the robotic arm to print the extrusion head to create a freely positioned and continuous path that replaces the traditional (hot melt) deposition. The shortcomings of the printed product method.
abstract_zh:
現今從工業到民生常見的三維列印機器(RepRap、3D printer)，使用的增材製造方法多以熔融沈積成型（Fused deposition modeling, FDM）技術為主。此技術廣泛應用在設計領域，但卻因為機具和材料等列印限制，常只能當作原型打樣使用，而缺乏更多設計上的應用。

非沉積列印(線列印)是一種更好的印刷方法，它部分改善了FDM缺點，降低了材料和時間成本，對於材料和對應機具使用的多樣性增加，且在製造流程中有更多設計應用的切入點。本研究的目的是開發一種方法，可以在三維空間中有效地生成線段和路徑，以及如何透過簡單地使用參數化軟體，將數位模型轉換為三維列印機和機器人的數控編成語言(G-code)，並以多種材料實驗和工具設計來製造。

研究主要分為三個部分: 第一是研究G-code和線性列印的關係與系統發展；第二是參數化和優化G-code生成的工法流程，再傳送到數位機具製造，如3D印表機等工具。第三是嘗試利用不同媒材和不同工具，紀錄參數化路徑製造的實驗及研究過程，並對於此技術的總結和未來應用探討。

研究過程中，利用常見的3D列印機和六軸機械手臂等數位工具，去做線列印實驗，藉由陶土材料、熱塑材料和複合材料等數個實驗，材料與製造技術相結合的絲綢成型方法，使建築師和設計師在未來的工程和施工方法上有更多的應用和開發。

此研究的重要性在於，利用簡單的參數化編輯軟體即可以任意操作3D印表機或是機械手臂列印擠出頭，來製造出自由定位且連續的路徑，取代過去傳統(熱融)沉積列印的產品工法的缺點。

title: An Open Source Model for Contemporary Collaborative Construction
title_zh: 當代合作建造之開源模型
abstract: Open-source projects are an emerging collaboration model. They enable people to open and release source codes in order to allow sharing and create a collaborative improvement. In the field of open-source projects, design drawings are uploaded by architects to the public domain, and members of the public can adapt these designs according to their own needs, thereby designing their own houses. However, currently, open-source architecture (OSArc) is more biased towards design. Compared with open-source design, open-source construction has been less explored. As a result, people can possess design drawings and yet not know where to start. Therefore, the aim of this study is to preliminarily probe an open-source model for contemporary collaborative construction. This thesis is divided into three parts. The first part is a literature review summarizing four types of collaborative constructions, including traditional settlements, modern construction plants, contemporary architects, and humanitarian architecture organizations, and integrates them into a theoretical model. The second part uses participant observation to review the revised model. The third part covers implementation by laying out the revised model in GitHub. This study proposes the theoretical model and a working approach for collaborative construction. Based on the GitHub demonstration framework, two humanitarian architecture projects are practically launched in Cambodia and Taitung. The contributions of this study to academic research are exploring the collaborative construction model based on ethnography and the literature review. In teaching practice, design–build programs have been established based on humanitarian architecture and participant observation. Working guidance is provided for the promotion of non-profit organizations involved in humanitarian architecture in the Asia-Pacific region.
abstract_zh: 開源專案（Open Source Project）是一種新興的合作模式，它倡導人們將程式碼或設計原稿以開放授權釋出，供大眾使用或加以改善，達到分享與合作改良的目的。這樣的開源文化在建築則形成由建築師開放設計圖至公有領域，公眾依自身需求改良設計進而自造屬於自己的房子。但現今開源建築（Open Source Architecture, OSArc）多集中在設計面向，與開源的設計（Open Source Design）相比，開源的建造（Open Source Construction）較少被觸及，致使人們擁有設計圖，卻不知從哪一個建造環節下手。因此，本研究目的在初探開源建築中的合作建造模型及一個可讓群眾參與合作建造的工具平台。研究分三階段：第一階段以文獻回顧與個案分析法，建立傳統聚落、營建專業者、建築專業者、義築組織等四種合作建造模式，並擷取共同類群與構成元素，綜理成一理論模型。第二階段以參與觀察法投入人道建築工作現場，透過實際的臨場觀察與紀錄，檢討第一階段理論模型，取得實務上施工現場的執行架構。第三階段以GitHub為工具平台，將第二階段檢討修正模型佈局其上，由參與者進行測試及實體構築。本研究成果：提出合作建造理論模型及實踐的工作方法，以GitHub為平台建立示範框架，並基於示範框架，實際於柬埔寨及台東執行二個構築測試。研究貢獻基於民族誌等文獻回顧法，探索人類文明中的合作建造模式。在教學實務上，基於參與觀察法，建立設計實作的課程模組。對非營利組織人道建築推動上，提供亞太區域群眾合作建造的工作指引。

title: A notation system for spatial movement
title_zh: 空間運動圖譜系統
abstract: In the early stages of the spatial design process, the designer always predicts the motion experience that involves moving through and between spaces in the static diagram. Designers usually use lines along with arrows to describe and predict the circulation of space. However, it is hard to convey the motion concept to the receiver in the static circulation graphics. This purpose of this study is to investigate the regular method of movement description through the notation system. The strategy of constructs a system of reference is used to improve the design communication and motivation during the design process. Purposive sampling is used to find information-rich cases that meet the criteria. In-depth interviews are used to gain the holistic understanding of spatial designer’s perspectives. The data analysis for each designer interviewed consisted of coding and categorizing. The results of this study showed that the type of space corresponds to the spatial behavior in the diagram. In addition, spatial information can depict the human body, behavior, and meaning through selection, combination, and summarization of symbols. Moreover, this study proposes a possible systematic framework to re-examine the relationship between designers and non-designers. Though the design communication can visualize the process which might help non-designers to switch the role from passive to active participation. To conclude, the narrative structure of the symbolic system might hinder the concept-expression, but it can help the design process in the design communicate of a large design case. Also, the presentation of motion experience allows designers to conduct a preliminary discussion about the elevation in the plan.
abstract_zh: 在設計初期的探索階段，空間設計者通常是經由靜態的空間圖解來預測人們穿梭與往返空間的動態經驗，運動被簡化為一種線段加箭頭的圖像符號組合，然而過於簡化的符號並無法有效的對動作的知覺經驗進行描述。本研究目的藉由圖譜系統來探討運動描述之約定俗成、慣性或其它可能的敘事性結構，並嘗試建構一個共通的參照系統來做為策略，以用於溝通經驗和強化設計溝通的價值與動機。本研究採用立意抽樣來選擇研究對象，使用深度訪談來去取得空間設計者的觀點和整體了解，針對每位設計師訪談所得的資料分析，分析包含對資料的編碼與分類。研究發現圖解中的空間類型直接反映出適切的空間行為，而空間資訊得以透過符號的積累、組合和歸納等方式，從中描繪出人們的身體、行為或是意義等資訊，此外，本研究提出一個可能的層級架構來重新審視專業者和非專業者的關係，而系統的建置除了能夠協助使用者以圖像化的方式進行溝通外，它亦可能使非專業者從被動參與轉為主動提供資訊的角色。總結而言，在不同的設計階段，符號系統的敘述性結構可能會阻礙設計概念的傳遞與表達，但它卻有助於對於大型或多人設計案件的溝通交流，而動態經驗的呈現得以讓設計者於平面圖解時即可對空間立面的運動進行初步的探討。

title: LIGHT CONFIG: IoT device interaction and configuration by Visible Light Communication
title_zh: LIGHT CONFIG：光通訊運用於物聯網設定之互動研究
abstract: There will be increasingly more devices that connect to the network in future smart homes. Before they connect to the net, they often have to go through many several complex steps in order to connect to the net. It is an important feature that will seriously degrade the user experience. In the IoT toolkit for learning purposes, we usually need modules with individual function through the physical interface concatenation to allow the usage, which also limits the usability. This paper reflects the study of the current artificial intelligent device settings in the home, trying to provide a faster and easier method for users to make the device online to replace the current complex settings. The sufficient use of the LED and visual light are as the interface to communicate with the device. LED lights has the visibility, directivity and scope. In addition to its limited distance, it is very suitable for use in the transmission for more privacy concerns. This study produces a simple, fast, cheap result that can be immediately used large scales in applications. This outcome can be applied to future smart homes and any internet devices, and it can also create more possibilities that the users interact with smart devices in a more intuitive and simple ways.
abstract_zh: 在未來的智慧居家中將有越來越多的裝置會連接到網路，在連接到網路之前，經常得透過複雜的步驟才能連接到網路，這是一個嚴重降低使用者體驗的重要環節。而在學習型的IoT toolkit上，通常都需要將個別的功能模組經由實體接口串接才能使用，因此侷限了使用性。在本研究中，探索目前在智慧家庭裝置的設定方式，試圖提供一種讓使用者更快更簡單可以令裝置上線的方法來替代目前繁瑣的設定，使用隨處可見的LED燈以及光通訊作為與裝置溝通的介面，LED燈具有的可見性、指向性與範圍性，還有其距離的限制，非常適合使用在傳輸較隱私的資料。 本研究的結果產生了一個簡單、快速、便宜、可以立即大量應用的使用方式，未來可以在智慧居家，甚至在任何物聯網裝置上都可以應用，也可以創造更多的可能性，使用者將可以用更直覺簡單的方式使用智慧裝置。

title: Differential Line Growth Algorithm Based Kinetic Art
title_zh: 差異擴散演算法轉譯機動藝術裝置之創作
abstract:
In the field of kinetic art, creators use "dynamic" as the core of their creation and make use of a variety of media to make the audience feel the dynamic effects they want to express. The research takes the form of kinetic art as the final presenting objectives. Dynamic content focuses on the "Dynamic process hidden behind the nature". I study generative algorithms as the basis transforming guideline.
In order to understand why it can be a life-like cause, in the era of computer and digital development diversified, algorithms are also used to explain the logic of many types of growth, which in turn can simulate the process of growth of various life forms in digital. In this research, it plays an important role, and uses relevant algorithms as the basis for understanding and transformation. It is hoped that through a series of researches and implementations, the realization of dynamic bionic possibilities in reality can be achieved.
After through the study of the generative algorithms, the "Differential Line Growth" algorithm, which can show the dynamic process of growth of brain coral, is selected as the final chosen core of the transforming system.
abstract_zh:
在現今的動力藝術（kinetic art）中，創作者以「動態」作為創作的核心，利用各種媒材，使觀眾可感知於其所想表達之動態效果，此研究因對於自然界的形態中能感受到生命感受，渴望能重現此感受在動力藝術雕塑中，動態的內容以「生物形態背後隱藏的動態過程」為核心，所展開的一連串探索與實踐模型。
為了瞭解這些生命感受的成因，在電腦以及數位發展多元的這個時代，演算法也被用來解釋許多型態成長的邏輯，進而可以在數位中模擬出各種生命形態成長的過程，而這些邏輯在此研究中，扮演著重要的角色，以相關的演算法作為理解以及轉化的依據，希望藉由一連串的研究以及實作，達到在現實中動態仿生可能性的實現。
最後選定能表現出生成腦珊瑚成長型態動態過程的「差異擴散成長」演算法作為動態呈現的依據核心，轉化演算法中的成型因素以及動力學，試圖轉化再現其在數位端模擬的動態，再現於現實的物理環境中，並且建立現實環境中的動力裝置系統後，再以實際系統的情況做數位端的修改，進而在數位端做驗證以及對比實驗，以及搭載皮層單元，使之在動態以外有著多元的形態變化延伸。

title: Forming and Fabrication of Foam Material
title_zh: 發泡成形工法與構築研究
abstract:
This research attempts to explore new manufacturing techniques of the expanding foam material (PU foam). We intend to find out the latent potential of foam material by manipulating the tendency of the growth of foam material, so the resulting object is shaped by the outer constraints and inner forces of the material.
We propose a new foaming process named as “Stencil Diversion Forming Method” by applying stencil during the foam growth process, with dynamic characteristics that is specific to the expanded material. We also experiment with complex morphological features with streamlined processes. For example, by controlling the tendency of the growth, the blowing agent may generate a topographical three-dimensional shape through the hole during expansion. Through the holes of the stencil the speed of expansion of the blowing agent can be varied. Along with the changing of directions of pouring or twisting, multiple factors work together to form a special shape after expanding. Although this forming method tried to control or influence the foam growth by the digitally designed stencils, the unpredictability of the forming process contributes to the unique and subtle differences between each generation of the resulting form.
Base on the foaming process, we have developed three foaming fabrication method named as “Growing Stacking Method” , “Expansion Deformation Method” and “Suspension Topological Printing Method”.
The Growth Stacking Method combines the two traditional fabricating methods - casting and stacking. Then we incorporates the most common function of the foam material - caulking and the Stencil Diversion Forming Method. So the method can be manufactured the structure and decoration at the same time. The Expansion Deformation Method attempts to fill the blowing agent with a double flat fabric to make it self-deforming into a three-dimensional shape. The Suspension Topological Printing Method uses robotic arm to print in a pool of foam particles to break through the limitations of current layered and linear printing, and also increase the manufacturing speed greatly.
abstract_zh:
本研究嘗試找尋突破於當前建築的材料與構築工法，參考生物生長的生成邏輯，並利用膨脹發泡材料(本研究選用PU Foam)作為建築材料，試圖發掘發泡材料所具有的膨脹與固化兩種特性所隱藏的應用潛能。本研究藉由引導發泡材料膨脹與流動的趨勢，讓建築能以類似於生長的方式自我構築，使得物體以材料自身的力道成形，並依此發展為專屬於膨脹材料且具有動態特色的新形態構築工法。
在工法的理念脈絡中，期望以盡量精簡的加工方式以及資訊內涵就能夠定義出複雜的形態特徵。例如由平面或是線性的元素能夠自動生成出的拓樸的立體造型，藉由節省資訊含量，可以使得造型更為複雜，並且更適合應用於各種施工環境。
本研究藉由探索發泡材料的材料特性後規劃出一種新式發泡成形工法命名為「孔洞導流成形法」，孔洞導流成形工法以發泡劑膨脹通過板片切割孔洞的方式改變發泡劑膨脹的速度差異以及傾倒方向，使得發泡劑膨脹後互相融合成特殊的造型。
研究後期以此發泡工法為基礎發展三種發泡構築工法，分別為「生長式堆疊法」、「膨脹變形法」、「懸浮拓樸列印法」。
生長式堆疊法結合鑄造與堆疊兩種傳統工法，並納入發泡材料常見的填縫功能以及前階段中孔洞導流成形法發掘的成形技術，整合為結構與裝飾一體製造的發泡工法。膨脹變形法試圖以雙層平面布料填充入發泡劑創造出能夠自我變形為立體造型的製造技術。而懸浮拓樸列印法以機械手臂在保麗龍顆粒中列印突破當前層積式與線性列印的造型限制與製造速度限制。以上四種發泡工法皆以簡單的控制方式創造出複雜的立體形態，使得製造技術因發泡材料的膨脹屬性而具有更多樣化的造型與成形方式。

title: Analysis and Applications of Theo Jansen's Linkage Mechanism
title_zh: 仿生獸連桿機構之解析與應用
abstract:
Dynamically adaptable structures in the building can be adapted and used to meet changing needs and actions. Institutions are also constantly improving and promoting the feasibility of their applications with the development of science and technology. Kinetic architecture generally includes functions of sunshade, ventilation, environmental regulation, and change of building form. Existing dynamic mechanism mostly develop due to a single purpose and have their limitations. This study tries to find out the dynamic mechanism of modularity, which can produce different application modes according to the different modes of structure adjustment and reach the possibility of applying a single institution to diversified systems. Theo Jansen's Strandbeest is composed of a connecting rod and a wind operating mechanism. The connecting rod mechanism is proportionally arranged by rods. When driven, the overall structure of the connecting rod and the wind operating system operate in a walking way, so that the structure produces biological actions. This study attempts to study the working principle of biomimicry, to explore the feasibility of the use of the building.
The analysis of this research includes the formation of biomimicry, the way of movement between rods, how the mechanism relies on the crank drive mechanism to form the locomotion steps. Changing the dynamic mode of the linkage mechanism and changing the length of the rod and the mode of construction make it different from the previous walking mode, with the possibility of stretching, opening and closing, gripping and free curvature change. Progress in digital software, an algorithmic mechanism is used to simulate the motion pattern of the linkage. Explore possible functions and try different combinations possibilities. The development of a simple test kit that can be quickly assembled and tested will be based on the modular design of linkage mechanism used in dynamic systems of different functions and the prototype system of different functions will be demonstrated.
abstract_zh:
建築中的動態適應性機構可依照需求進行變化與動作，而符合使用需求，隨科技的發展，此類機構也不斷改善與增進其應用的可行性。動態建築一般包括遮陽、通風、環境調節、建築形體變化等功能，現有的動態機構多因應單一目的而發展，有其限制性。本研究試著找出模組化的動態機構，可隨調節架構方式的不同，而產生不同的應用方式，達成單一機構運用於多樣化系統的可能性。Theo Jansen的仿生獸由連桿與風力運作機構組成，連桿機構經由桿件比例配置，驅動時整體架構會如同步行的方式運行，使無機物構造產生如生物般的動作。本研究企圖研究仿生獸的運作原理，來探討在於建築上利用的可行性。
本研究之分析包括仿生獸的型態構造、桿件之間的牽動方式、機構如何依靠曲柄驅動機構形成步法等，並改變連桿機構動態模式以及變換桿件的長短、組構模式，使其運動方式不同以往的步行模式，而是能有伸展、開合、夾取、自由曲度變化的可能性。接著在數位軟體中，使用演算法機制模擬連桿的運動模式，探索可能機能，嘗試不同組合可能性。然後，發展可快速組裝測試的簡易實驗套件，將連桿機構以模組化的設計，運用於不同機能的動態系統，並製作不同機能之雛形系統進行示範。

title: Investigation of Biomimetic Robotic Construction Process
title_zh: 以機械手臂進行仿生構築之流程與工法研究
abstract: In this thesis, we use beavers as biomimetic objects to develop biomimetic robotic construction process. Beavers are famous as natural architects. The structure of beaver dam is stable and the dimension is large. The mechanism of constructing beaver dam includes two processes. First, beavers select proper woods for construction and use streams to aggregate those woods to be self-assembled. This kind of natural materials is commonly seen in nature. Typhoons and rivers erode trees into mass driftwoods. These driftwoods are difficult to utilize by conventional construction process and are often discarded or burned. Therefore, if we can make good use of these natural materials instead of throwing them away, we can save lots of resources and provide design field with new possibilities. In this Implementation, we use sticks as scaled-down driftwoods. Biomimetic robotic construction process utilizes six degree of freedom robot and 3D camera and improves construction through machine learning. The machine learning mechanism estimates the relation between material properties and structure stability. Thus, the construction robot can select proper sticks for self-assembly by adapting local natural materials.
abstract_zh:

title: Design with Bamboo Bend- Bridging Natural Material and Computational Design
title_zh: 用竹片彎曲做設計-自然材料與數位設計之結合
abstract:
This research was motivated by a built bamboo pavilion, of which the intent was focus on how to design with the natural forming by the bamboo strips when bent. However, the biggest problem encountered during the design process was the bend curve couldn’t be defined or described in 3D environment. Due to a significant characteristic of natural material, heterogeneity, the form created by force is irregular and hard to predict. Subsequently, spatial review and structural analysis couldn’t be evaluated. Unlike conventional geometric-defined design approach, the form of the built bamboo pavilion is generated by material behavior, this kind of design approach should be based on the material properties and material behavior analysis, and should be aided by the computability of digital design tool.

In order to deal with the heterogeneity and the irregularity, generally, natural material is coupled with crafting techniques, which has instant interaction between material the maker. However, the demand of digital system is reliability and consistency of information exchange, precise material data is needed. Therefore, without a model to describe bamboo strips bend behavior, material data and material study results couldn’t be inserted into the digital system for design usage.

This research demonstrated how to bridge the gap between natural material and digital system by 4 parts: bamboo strips bend experiments, bamboo strips bend parametric model, form generator and assembly from material suggestion. A database is constructed based on the parametric model which combined with material experiments, bamboo strips bend behavior analysis, bend form variables and bamboo strips bend characteristics. Additionally, a bamboo strips design tool is proposed, to generate behavior-driven form, and to achieve the goal of form prediction and material suggestion from the database.

As a result, digital system not only carries material knowledge that craftsmen obtain by experiences, but also shifts the way that natural material generally coupled with crafting techniques. The shift reduces construction techniques level and bridges the gaps between stages of crafting techniques. Furthermore, bamboo strips characteristics and data exchange in the process of automation in the digital system, has created an opportunity for better elaboration of material, which no longer just a by-product of geometry-centric design approach. Finally, we may pursue innovative digital crafting with significant potentials.
abstract_zh:
本研究的動機來自於一實際竹構築的案例，思考如何用剖竹片的自然彎曲形態做設計，然而在設計過程中所遇到最大的問題是竹片彎曲曲線無法在3D環境被定義或描繪。由於自然材料其中一大特色是非均值性，使它在外力下產生的形態不平整而難以預測其形態，造成後續的空間檢視和結構分析等沒有評估的依據。別於傳統的定義幾何形體的設計方法，案例中的設計方法是以材料行為為誘發因子產生形態，這樣的設計方法需要材料屬性和行為分析以及數位工具的可運算能力做輔助。

由於材料特性，一般而言自然材料搭配的是可以與材料即時互動的工藝生產技術，來面對不均值以及不規格化的材料特性。而數位系統對材料資訊的訴求是可靠性和一致性的資訊交換，需要的是精準的材料資訊。因此，如果沒有一個模型來描述竹片彎曲行為，材料資訊以及所做的材料試驗結果無法直接置入數位設計系統中運算和使用。

為了要連接這兩者間的斷層，本研究透過竹片彎曲試驗、竹片彎曲行為參數模、建築形體生成和材料建議與組裝四部分展示了如何將自然材料和數位設計結合。透過一系列的材料試驗和參數模搭配、分析竹片彎曲行為、整理影響竹節彎曲形態的變數、歸納出彎曲特性以及將這些資訊建成資料庫。最後提出一個竹片設計工具，可設計出具有竹片彎曲行為的形體，並藉由資料庫達到形體預測和材料準備建議的目標。

最後，用數位系統不僅承載了工藝師對材料的知識，也改變了自然材料搭配的傳統工藝技術生產方式，降低傳統工藝技術的施工門檻和各階段的斷層。除此之外，竹材特性和資訊傳遞在數位系統中自動化的過程中，創造了自然材料發揮更大的特性的機會，不再只是幾何形態導向設計的附屬品，這使得我們有了更高的進行創新的數位構築的可能性。

title: A spatial map of screenplay
title_zh: 電影劇本架構模型視覺化
abstract:
Screenplay is not only the crucial impact of movies, but also a work manual for crews. The information in the screenplay is the hint for everything. As a result, the amount of information are considerable. Therefor there will be several conditions during the process：1. Information organized：user just table the information from screenplay, but there is no linked between the form and screenplay. Once the screenplay had changed, the form will be useless；2. The timeline of screenplay is linear, but people cannot see the full view of story from tradition screenplays.

In the digital age, people receive numerous of information everyday but unable to absorb efficiently. Thus, data visualization is always the best way for people to absorb information. However, the method of data visualization rarely used in screenplay. For all the narrative forms, the movie screenplay may be the most suitable for computational analysis and visualization owing to the specific formatting conventions that enable an algorithmic approach to analyzing and visualizing film narratives.

This thesis builds will be able to build a system that can retrieve the basic information form screenplays and visualized the data. Just like planning a map, readers can see not only the full view but also details. Base on the analysis result, this project could help the crew of movie group to read the information and discuss more efficiently.
abstract_zh:
電影劇本對於電影整體成就的影響是最大的，也是所有劇組人員的工作手冊。劇本裡所承載的資訊，是一切的藍圖，相對來說，其資訊量也相當可觀，但對工作人員人數也不少的劇組來說，面對這些巨量資料，通常都會在製作過程中衍生出幾個狀況：1. 劇本資料的整裡，通常劇組人員對於劇本資料的整裡，僅是將資料表格化，但兩者間是單獨存在並無連動性，一旦劇本有任何修改，就必須再做重複的步驟，並且費時；2. 劇本的時間軸是線性的，但資訊呈現是分場次的，僅以紙本文字呈現的劇本，閱讀範圍有限，很容易失去各段關係的連結。

在資訊爆炸的數位時代中，人們每天面對巨量的資料，卻無法及時消化，用資料視覺化將資訊映射到人腦中，一直都是幫助人類吸收資訊的最好方式。在視覺化早已被廣泛運用的年代理，卻鮮少被運用在敘事文本上。以眾多的敘事文本形式中，電影劇本是一個非常適合運用電腦分析以及視覺化的形式，因為電影劇本裡的各項資訊，本身就已擁有專屬的格式或是代稱，很容易被電腦判讀。

本研究將建立一套能夠擷取劇本基本資訊並將之視覺化的系統，在所創造的資訊空間裡，以直觀的方式對應劇本裡的電影空間，以分析過後所產生出的概念模型，就像建立一份地圖，有明確的主要幹道指引方向，在改變比例尺的情況下，也可以細看小巷弄中的樣貌，在縱覽與細節之間，幫助劇組人員快速建立該部片的主要架構，提供工作人員在討論交流時的依據。全觀性的閱讀模式也讓各段故事的關係不容易失去連結。

title: Developing a Process and Toolkits for the Sampling and Visualization of Environmental Color Scheme
title_zh: 環境色票的工具流程開發與視覺化
abstract:
This research proposes a new process and a toolkit to pick colors and mash up with Google Maps to build the foundation of the environmental color and Dynamic Color Scheme to become a platform of interoperable open data. If a large amount of environmental schemes are accumulated, this system can be used for National Land Use Monitoring Program.

This research simplifies the process of color sampling, color picking then analyzes photos by toolkits creating Environmental Color Scheme (ECS). ECS is a type of Dynamic Color Scheme (DCS) and Personalized Color Scheme (PCS). DCS is dynamically redefined depending on certain contexts, e.g. location and mood, and PCS is used in fashion, personal preferences and so on. In practice, PCS & DCS exist already, for example in landscape design, and this research tries to extend their diversity to knowledge sharing, collective contributions and crowd intelligence.

This thesis builds a workflow of color picking and color scheme, that consist of obtaining environmental samples, toolkit, image processing and visualization. Moreover, the process links several software and platforms, including Photoshop and Google Maps by scripting, so that users can easily and effectively collect valid and substantial environmental color samples. In addition, the color analysis of environment is going to help us on design or planning orders to reach the basic situation of the surrounding.
abstract_zh:
顏色一直是人們第一件注意到的事，更是最容易讓人感受到"美"的媒介。在我們生活的環境中，可以說是色彩定義了各種物件的意義。樹是綠的，天空跟河川是藍的，水泥是灰的，遠近的不同，看到的色彩也不一樣，人們用眼睛看到的色彩可能因為他在時空中的位置不同隱含了各種意思，人們蒐集這個空間的顏色，則可拼湊出一整個區域的立體色彩空間。

色彩學是門古老的研究，比起冷硬的學說，人類對色彩的理解更傾向直覺的反應。世界上有許多機構一直在探討與追尋精準的色彩標示，這些色彩權威機構對於色彩應用與定義一直都是不可撼動的，因為他們掌握了如何提取色彩與標準化這些流程與數據，但在數位工具普及下，人們能更方便的紀錄與蒐集眼前所看到的一切圖像，快速的分析出圖像中的顏色並以網路分享到各個平台，讓更多人對美感產生共鳴。色彩的去權威化漸漸變成了顯學，使的色彩更容易被看見與應用。但一直以來，圖片蒐集取色都是一項封閉的行為，對圖片打卡標記為流行已久並很普遍的做法，但因為色票主要在呈現顏色而非景色，所以並沒有標注地點的習慣。回到最原始的使用習慣，色票搜集的最前端---素材蒐集為環境景色，並從景色中分析出顏色後，座標位置就對色票產生了意義，讓顏色可以放到地圖分享平台並做比對，後續產生更多的新型使用方式並讓色彩更容易被看見。

本研究建立一套關於環境的取色流程與色票，包含如何取得環境樣本，取色工具，影像處理與環境色相表現法，應用方法等，其中影像處理串連多個電腦輔助設計軟體，包括Photoshop與Google Maps的軟體整合，讓使用者可以更簡易，更快採集到有效且大量的環境色彩樣本，有助於掌握這個區域的基本環境狀況，用於多種設計或規劃層面。

abstract_zh:
現今傳統建築五金之設計發展已臻至成熟，隨著電腦輔助設計與電腦輔助製造，以及參數化設計的進步，使得自由形體的建築設計更為常見，傳統的建築五金已不能應付以此設計流程生成的設計。

於此，因傳統建築五金的制式化使得其功能無法隨著當代設計進行使用，大量客製化及差異化生產，為現今以此方法作為建築設計之施作端最為顯著的課題，如何將傳統的建築五金藉由現代技術使其能處理當代建築的複雜性，如何在設計階段可一併考量到施作端需要注意到的內容?

本研究以玻璃爪具作為傳統建築五金之範例，藉由案例分析及玻璃爪具之特性，結合當代3D Printer的技術，以參數化設計之流程進行施作步驟的討論，及施作縮尺模型討論其可行性。本研究內容可分為兩階段：1. 建立玻璃爪具所屬之特定參數化系統，並藉由此系統建立出一可因應各條件設立，即時反饋出一結果。2. 將其結果以一自由曲面進行比例模型之施作，以討論其可行性及製造流程。

title: A Biomimetic Multi-Joint System for Adaptive Shading
title_zh: 仿生適應性關節系統: 以遮陽為例
abstract:
Adaptive architecture is more and more popular in modern architecture, shades are frequently used for adjusting skylight and climate. Shades such as mechanical canopies are mostly mechanically constructed and controlled by centralized control systems to achieve automation in a smart building. Such system not only can't adapt to every angle of the sunshade during the day and the year, it is also vulnerable to mechanical problems. When a tiny bit of the system goes wrong, the shades simply halt.

There are similar systems in the nature, with superior design -- such as joint system of Stingray's softbone -- it is simple, modular, redundant, work together and fail proof. Even if some of the joints malfunction, the whole process of fin waving is intact. In search for feasible solution for adaptive shading, we therefore focus on developing a multi-joint system by learning from the nature.

This paper proposes a multi-joint system for adaptive shading, which is a biomimetic design inspired from Stingray. Joints of the system are produced by 3D printer. By choosing every single part of the system, residents will have a shading system, which really adapt to their life and the environment.
abstract_zh:
適應性建築在當代獲得極大的重視，遮陽則為最常見的適應性建築系統。遮陽也被賦予調節天光與氣候等外在環境的責任，但目前的機械遮陽設備依然有其缺點所在，以機械遮陽棚為例，此遮陽系統所提供的遮陽模式過少，並不能真正適應在一年中每一天每一個時刻都不同的太陽角度，容易造成過度遮陽或是過度曝曬的效果。除此之外，這種機械系統只要其中有一個環節錯誤，即會導致整個遮陽機制停擺。

自然界有類似的設計，並且能夠解決我們正面對的問題。以魟魚的關節系統為例，它很簡單，模組化，利用冗餘設計和協同運作的概念解決因為一個環節出錯所造成的系統停擺問題。即使有些關節停止運作，魟魚在水中的運動仍然不會停止。因此，本研究應向自然學習，以創造出一個適應性關節系統為目標，第一個原型為遮陽系統。

本研究學習魟魚等多關節水中生物，提出了一種適應性關節系統，以遮陽為原型。此系統的關節利用3D列印技術製造。透過選擇此系統的每一個部分，居民能夠擁有一套真正不只能夠適應外在環境同時能夠適應他們生活習慣的適應性遮陽系統。

title: Form & Force: The Dynamic Design Under Digital Thinking
title_zh: 形，勢 ─ 數位思維下之動態設計
abstract_zh:
數位一詞在建築設計領域經常被置放在三個與設計實踐緊密相關的定位，其一，作為最具效能之工具，快速生產建築之分身，取代製圖、模型、透視等建築再現途徑。其二，藉由運算作為強大的分析工具，精確模擬複雜之幾何、物理性質，再輔以CAM( 電腦輔助製造Computer-Aided Manufacturing, CAM)技術，大幅提升建築營造之效率與可能性。其三，輔助設計者將模糊概念藉由程式化、參數化運算，轉化為具體幾何形式，大幅容忍傳統技法在合理時間成本中無法企及之設計複雜度，甚至在多重參數定義下，以模組方式混合出自動生成之備選方案，如此的設計流程轉變，啟發了本設計論文的主要概念——「形，勢」。

「形，勢」二字取自《孫子·虛實》：「夫兵形象水，水之行，避高而趨下；兵之形，避實而擊虛。水因地而制流，兵因敵而制勝。故兵無常勢，水無常形，能因敵變化而取勝者，謂之神。」當今數位設計影響建築形式甚巨，其中大幅度改變當代設計流程中形式生成之原創脈絡的便是藉由「動態變化」而生成「新形式」的法則，這裡我以「形，勢」稱之，並將此現象轉化為設計概念，這些法則透過參數定義與運算呈現出實際可變動的裝置，或是帶有動態傾向的造型。本研究透過三大主題探討動態變化與「形，勢」之呈現，詮釋數位思維下之設計實踐。

首先，為衍生式設計之實驗性作品，以一件變形雕塑呈現，預示變形物件介入空間，影響活動、感知的可能性；其次，面對空間，將別墅視為一連串生活機能組構而成的內向物件，以人在空間中的活動為基礎，探討實體生活空間的連續性與離散性。第三，基於智慧材料熱雙金屬，研究在不額外耗能的前提之下以機構設計達成動態感應之成果，以單元形式發展出隨環境反應之溫度、氣流感知裝置。

title: Experiencing energy – Physical Representation of Energy Consumption
title_zh: 體驗能源 - 能耗資訊實體化研究
abstract:
Electricity is an invisible resource around our world and also the foundation of modern civilization. User can not realize about its existence until electric equipment start working. Traditionally, user just can through the meter or from the bill mail by the electricity company in the end of month to know how much electricity they used. User cannot make intuitive connection between behavior and energy waste because the location of meter install and the way to provide information. How to combine the interactive device into spatial elements to show the information of electricity used by ambience way, let the user can understand easily and will to change the way use of electrical appliances is the topic lots of people discussing in the field of smart housing. Reconsider of the problem about the relationship between user experience and energy information, it could improve the situation by provide a good interactive display system which interdisciplinary cooperate with information and cognitive technology.

This design research try to develop an entity interactive interface device : Energy Leafs. By read the energy consumption information from EMU system and show it with appearance changes passing the ambience information to user. Shape and behavior of interactive device will design with the research about entity cognitive experience and induction-type scenario. On the other hand, combined with interactive technology and art design that make devices more attractive and beauty which expected can change user behavior better than before is this design research wants to do.
abstract_zh:
電能是一種無形的資源，環繞著人類社會的生活環境，是建構現代物質文明的基礎。日常生活環境中，使用者不會感受到電能的存在，直到它被作用且驅動空間中的設備，傳統上想要接收了解有關能源消耗多寡的介面只能透過閱讀電表轉盤的刻度或是電力公司每月寄出表單上的資訊。電表的裝設位置、運作系統和資訊提供方式，讓使用者無法直覺地將空間中進行的行為和所消耗的能源狀況做認知上的連結；每月的表單也無法及時提供資訊。如何將顯示耗能資訊的實體互動裝置結合於建築空間元素之中，以營造環室顯示的概念的方式，讓使用者更容易了解當下的能耗資訊，誘導使用者做行為上的改變，並且進一步選擇、改變日常生活在建築空間中的能源使用配置，是目前智慧型建築和資通訊科技領域中許多人在討論的課題。重新考慮在建築空間中，有關連結使用者生活經驗和能耗資訊的裝置給予使用者的操作感知落差、資訊認知斷層的設計問題，經由和其他資訊、認知領域的跨界合作，提供一套良好的互動顯示系統應能改善現況。
本研究設計旨在發展一套實體互動介面裝置：Energy Leafs，置入日常生活空間的背景環境，擷取智能電紋系統測量的能耗量化資訊，以裝置的外型狀態變化來顯示各種設備能耗與使用狀況，透過非強制性與間接性的資訊傳遞、程式參數化的控制，轉化為空間情境的訊息，包括擬態物體的形體變化，傳達給建築空間中活動的使用者。期望能透過此互動方式，提供使用者能源資訊的消長狀況，讓資訊透明化、直覺化，誘導使用者在獲得相關資訊後，可依據情況需求，改變能源使用行為，進而達到良好的能源管理的效果。Energy Leafs實體介面的型態設計和行為設計，將建立在使用者對於實體消長狀態的認知經驗和誘導式的情境設計，和過去的生活經驗連結，使用者將依循相關脈絡嘗試互動方式，產生此能源資訊互動顯示裝置和空間能源資訊的連結性。另一方面，結合現代互動科技與美術空間設計元素，使裝置更具吸引力與美感，以達到改變使用者行為能產生比預期更好的效果，也是本研究設計最後期望達到的成果。

title: A Tangible Interaction Module for Motion Learning and Information Transmission
title_zh: 可進行動作學習與資訊傳遞的實體互動模組
abstract: Inspired by the Biomimetic Design, Swarm Intelligent, Information Communication and Psychology of Learning, this design research proposes a module called Motion Transmission Kit (MTK) that is able to learn the motion from user’s teaching and information transmission. We expect to allow the user to teach motion directly to the motor on the integrated device, so as to bridge designer’s imagination and realization of the mechanism, as well as to explore the design of multi-device communications. The prototype module and its example applications take advantage of Arduino, Processing, 3D printer, etc., to explore the possibility of its applications and potential issues. In addition, to increase the flexibility and types of application, the module takes the environmental factors into account during the design phase. First of all, users can teach motion to a single module. Secondly, motion between each module will be transmitted directly or indirectly. Users can easily use the basic functions provided by the module to simplify the complicated wiring and coding process. User can rapidly explore the relationships between mechanical components and the dynamicity, therefore be more focused on realization and improvement of the design prototype.
abstract_zh: 受到仿生設計、社會性生物群體智慧、資訊傳播理論和學習心理學的啟發，本設計研究提出可進行動作學習與資訊傳遞的實體互動模組Motion Transmission Kit (MTK)，期待讓使用者以教導動作方式對馬達進行控制，並與機構裝置結合，藉由此實踐創作者對於運動與機構的想像，以及探索多裝置間的通訊傳導設計。該雛形模組利用Arduino、Processing、3D printer等技術製作原型與應用範例，探討模組使用可能性與潛在議題。此外，為增加應用與探索的可能性，本模組將環境控制變因加入設計過程，讓使用者一開始先對單一模組產生教導動態行為，在模組間互相傳導動作，動作將在傳遞中產生堆疊、削減等變化，間接或直接地讓整體動態造形產生改變。使用者可透過模組所提供的基本功能，大幅簡化電路接線與程式碼撰寫的步驟，即刻探索機構元件之間的關係和動態產生的過程，專注於設計雛型的實踐與改善。
